description: Turn an objective into an ordered, checkable implementation plan grounded in the code.

inputs.name: objective
inputs.description: What the task must achieve, from the task record.

inputs.name: acceptanceCriteria
inputs.description: Conditions the result is checked against.

outputs.name: plan
outputs.description: Numbered steps naming files and checks, followed by risks.

steps.description: Restate the objective and every acceptance criterion in your own words, and list what must not change.
steps.evidence: The restated criteria and the protected behavior.

steps.description: Use the repository map (explore-repository) to find each file the change touches and each test that covers it.
steps.evidence: path:line citations for the affected code and tests.

steps.description: Order the work into small numbered steps. Each step names the files it changes and how it will be checked.
steps.evidence: A numbered plan whose steps each name files and a check.

steps.description: List what could break, how you would notice, and what you would do instead.
steps.evidence: A risks section with detection for each risk.
